# Claude Code Environment Variables: Context and Compaction

These 57 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover the context window, compaction, memory, and the prompt cache.
Compaction means that Claude Code replaces a long chat with a short summary.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=80` before `claude` to compact earlier, when the window is 80 percent full.
Or put `{ "env": { "CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE": "80" } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).

| Name | Mark | What It Does | Value | Where It Works |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` | ✅ | Lowers the percentage of the window at which auto-compaction starts. | Text. Also used for the fork compaction check | Main sessions and subagents. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_AUTO_MEMORY_OFF` | 🔍 | The dispatcher sets `1` on a background session when auto memory is off. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | Text. Claude Code sets it at spawn and scrubs it from child env | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_MEMORY_TOGGLED_OFF` | 🔍 | Tells a background session that memory was turned off. The session then calls its memory-off handler. | Text. Acts only when the value is `1` and `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND` is `bg`. The dispatcher sets it | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD` | ✅ | Loads memory files from `--add-dir` directories. | On or off. The remote `add_directory` request also needs it set in the container | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` | ✅ | Sets the auto-compact window in tokens. It is capped at the model context window. | Text. Invalid values are ignored. Project `env` may set it before trust | All sessions, allowed in. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_BLOCKING_LIMIT_OVERRIDE` | 🔍 | Overrides the context blocking limit for tests. Claude Code passes it as `testBlockingOverride`. | A number | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_COLD_COMPACT` | 🔍 | A getter returns its value next to the autocompact code. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` | ✅ | Turns off 1M context. Removes `[1m]` model variants and keeps 1M models at 200K. | On or off. Warns about a missing auto compact window when set | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` | ✅ | Turns off attachment processing, so `@` mentions stay plain text. Also turns off kept deferred tools. | On or off. Docs: ignored in project and local settings | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY` | ✅ | Turns auto memory off. A value of `0` forces it on, even in bare mode or with `autoMemoryEnabled: false`. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS` | ✅ | Stops all `CLAUDE.md` memory files from loading. | On or off. The loaders return an empty list when set | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` | ✅ | Stops `@` mention expansion. Claude gets the paths with a note to read them. | On or off. Docs: ignored in project and local settings. Claude Code also passes it to auto mode classifier children | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` | ✅ | Removes built-in commit and PR instructions and the git status snapshot. Beats `includeGitInstructions`. | On, off, or unset, on by default. When set to any parsed value, the result is its negation. Else the setting, default on | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_BULK_INFLATE` | 🔍 | Skips the bulk pull of all memory files from a memory store backend. | On or off. A feature flag also gates it | Memory store sync |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_MASS_DELETE_HOLD` | 🔍 | Sets the memory mass delete threshold to infinity. The threshold is otherwise the larger of 50 and 10 percent of the files. | On or off, off by default | Memory store sync |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_PERIODIC_RESYNC` | 🔍 | Sets the memory store resync interval to 0, which turns the periodic resync off. | On or off, 60 by default. Otherwise the interval is a feature flag, default 60 | Memory store sync |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_RO_UNSAVED_NOTICE` | 🔍 | Skips the scan that warns about unsaved writes in a read-only memory store mount. | On or off, off by default | Memory store sync. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_STREAM_LIST` | 🔍 | Skips the streamed metadata listing in memory store sync. | On or off. A feature flag also gates it | Memory store sync |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ORG_MEMORY` | 🔍🧪 | Makes the org memory gate return false. That gate also needs an internal flag. | On or off, off by default | Org memory |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PRECOMPACT_SKIP` | 🔍 | The transcript loader reads it when it loads a transcript. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off, off by default | Transcript loading |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT` | ✅ | Skips proactive auto-compaction at an assumed window for a model id that Claude Code does not know. | On or off. Messages say it restores the earlier wait-for-the-API behavior | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TOKEN_USAGE_ATTACHMENT` | 🔍 | Adds a `token_usage` attachment with used, total, and remaining tokens to the turn. | On or off, off by default | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_EVALUATE_MEMORY` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_MEMORY_SURVEY` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` | ✅ | Sets the context size in tokens where idle compaction applies. It also feeds the sleep compaction timer. | A number. Whole number min `1`, whole value. Unset uses a built-in default | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_JUNIPER_SUNDIAL` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the number of turns between maintenance runs, default `10`. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | A number. Whole number min `1`, digits only. Order is env, then client data a feature flag, then the flag of that name, then `10` | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` | ✅ | Overrides the context window that Claude Code assumes for the model, when the model id allows it. | A number. A value above `0` counts. Also used with `DISABLE_COMPACT` | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_API_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | The name appears only in a list of env names. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | A URL | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_API_TOKEN` | 🔍❌ | Would set an `Authorization` header of type `Bearer` for the `memory` API host. In this build the guard always returns nothing, so the branch never runs. | Text (a secret) | Unknown |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_PUSH_DELETE_MODE` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the delete mode for memory push. Values are `corroborate`, `immediate`, and `never`. | `corroborate` by default. `enum`. Unset reads a feature flag, default `corroborate` | Memory sync |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY` | 🔍 | Turns on the hosted post-turn memory extraction pass. It needs a valid `CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_CONFIG`. | On or off. With a missing or bad config the code logs a warning and the pass stays off | Cloud and hosted sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_CONFIG` | 🔍 | Gives the JSON config of the post-turn memory pass. | JSON text | Cloud and hosted sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_SYNC` | 🔍 | Makes the post-turn memory pass run after every turn with no idle flush delay. | On or off. Sets `every_n_turns` to 1 and the idle flush to 0 | Cloud and hosted sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_MEMORY_DIR` | 🔍 | Sets the memory base dir in a cloud session. It also keeps auto memory on there. | Text | Cloud sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RIPPLING_TULIP` | 🔍🧪 | Overrides an internal flag value for the total-tokens reminder. A positive whole number sets the reminder size. | A number. Must be a positive safe integer. It does nothing when the reminder is off or attachments are disabled | Total-tokens reminder. Also blocked by `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` and `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SLEEP_COMPACT` | 🔍 | Turns on sleep compaction. A timer queues `/compact` while the session idles and before the prompt cache expires. | On or off. Active only on a host that qualifies. The timer fires at 0.9 of the cache time window | Idle sessions on supported hosts |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SLEEP_COMPACT_AFTER_MS` | 🔍 | Sets how long after a turn ends the sleep compaction may fire. | A number of milliseconds. Integer 1 or more. The code clamps it between 60000 and 210000 ms | Idle sessions with sleep compaction |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TOASTY_THIMBLE` | 🔍🧪 | Overrides the batching reminder, a prompt note that tells the model to request all independent tool calls in one response. | Text. The accepted values are not shown here | Models served with the reminder |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER` | 🔍 | Sets the mode of the `total_tokens` reminder that shows the tokens left. `off` turns it off. | Text. Known modes include `off`, `padded-countdown`, `infinite`, and `fixed`. Env wins over settings and flag | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER_AFTER_USER_TURN` | 🔍 | Chooses if the `total_tokens` reminder shows after each user prompt and re-anchors the budget on each user turn. | On, off, or unset, on by default. Env wins over settings and a feature flag | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER_BUDGET` | 🔍 | Sets the starting token budget for the `padded-countdown` reminder mode. | A number, `15000000` by default. Integer above 0. Env wins over settings and flag | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_EXTRA_GUIDELINES` | 🔍 | Adds extra guideline text to the auto memory and agent memory prompts. | Text. Ignored when empty | Cowork hosts |
| `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES` | 🔍 | Replaces the auto memory prompt with `# auto memory` plus this text. It also forces file-based memory. | Text. Needs auto memory on | Cowork hosts |
| `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_INDEX_CONTENT` | 🔍 | Supplies the memory index text and not the file. An empty string turns the injection off. | Text | Cowork hosts |
| `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE` | 🔍 | Sets the auto memory directory. It also keeps auto memory on in remote mode. | Text. Must be a valid absolute path, else it is ignored | Cowork hosts |
| `CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES` | 🔍 | Mounts extra memory stores from a JSON list. While set, it also turns the org memory feature off. | - | - |
| `CLAUDE_PROJECT_UUID` | 🔍🧪 | Names a Claude project. Claude Code fetches the project context block and the project memory index for it. | - | - |
| `DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` | ✅ | Turns off automatic compaction. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_COMPACT` | ✅ | Turns off all compaction. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING` | ✅ | Turns off prompt caching for all models. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_FABLE` | ✅ | Turns off prompt caching for Fable models. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` | ✅ | Turns off prompt caching for the default Haiku model. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_MYTHOS` | 🔍 | Turns off prompt caching for models that the Mythos check matches. | On or off | - |
| `MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | ✅ | Sets the token limit for one MCP tool result. | A number | - |
| `SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET` | ✅ | Overrides the character budget for the skill listing shown to the model. | A number, 1 by default. Integer, min `1`. If set, it wins over the dynamic budget (context window times 4 times a fraction, default 1%) | All sessions |
| `SYSTEM_REMINDER_MEMORY_CONTEXT` | 🔍🧪 | A truthy value helps turn on a memory-context gate, but only for some entrypoints. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off. Also in the list of known names | Gated by an entrypoint check |
| `USE_API_CONTEXT_MANAGEMENT` | 🔍🧪 | Would turn on the API context-management beta. It is inert in 2.1.303. | On or off. The code ANDs it with a constant false, so it has no effect | Inert, first-party models |
